story.jaymoskingdoms.road.title: What sets you on the road now?
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.city: Down on your luck in a rich city
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.city.tale: Now you are down on your luck in a rich city, with hardly a coin to your name and only the old tools of your trade.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.banished.tale: Now %s has banished you, and you wake beyond its borders.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.cave.tale: Now a caving trip has gone wrong, and you wake deep underground: poisoned, wounded and barely breathing.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.shipwreck.tale: Now your ship lies wrecked on a strange shore, and you crawl out of the debris.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.sworn.tale: Now you have sworn to serve %s, and you stand before its keep.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.village.tale: Now you arrive at a village to start over, among folk who will take you as you are, ready to take up whatever work it has.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.monolith.tale: Now something has drawn you to an ancient monolith. You can feel it humming.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.wild.tale: Now you are alone in the wild, far from anyone.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.skyfall.tale: Now you have fallen from the sky, from somewhere far above, and you drift down into the crater your landing should have made.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.timelost.tale: Now you have slipped out of your own time, and wake in a ruined city a lifetime ahead, with the dead walking its streets.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.timelost.short: A lifetime ahead, among the dead.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.burned.tale: Now your village is burning. You wake choking in what's left of your home, soot on your face, holding the few things you saved, and the village burns all round you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.snowed: Snowed in on a mountain pass
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.snowed.tale: Now the snows have caught you on a high mountain pass, and you wake half-frozen with only a lantern and a fur coat.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.captive.tale: Now you have cut your ropes and slipped out of a barbarian camp with nothing but your fists, and they are coming after you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.whalers.tale: Now you have signed on with a whaling crew as her harpooner, and you stand on her deck while she fits out for the deep.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.fate.tale: Now fate will decide where your road begins.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.unarmed.tale: Now you set out unarmed, quite literally: you lost a limb long ago, and the stump healed over years back.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.moon.tale: Now the miners' pod you crewed has come down hard on the Pale Moon, and you are the only one who walked away from it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.moon.short: The pod's only survivor, on the Pale Moon.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.verdant.tale: Now you are grown, in a village of the Verdant World where you were raised, and the gate to the Lookout calls you down to the world below.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.verdant.short: Called down from the Verdant World.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.rustfall.tale: Now you have broken out of the Iron-Master's mines on Rustfall, where you dug since you were small, and his overseers are already after you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.maw.tale: Now the black hole has taken your salvage crew, and you are alone on the landing pad at the Maw's edge with an empty hold.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.demon.tale: Now you leave the hall of the demon master who took you in as a child, deep in the Nether, to find out what you are.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.afterlife.tale: Now you have died young and woken among the dead in the Other World, and something there has marked you for one more go at life.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.afterlife.shor: Back from the dead for one more go.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.chained.tale: Now you are shackled in a barbarian camp among its other captives, with a lockpick hidden in your sleeve.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.rock_bottom.ta: Now you have nothing left: a limb long gone, an empty belly and not a coin, and an outlaw camp lies in plain sight.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.sentenced.tale: Now %s has sentenced you, and you wake in the cells under its seat with days still to serve.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.evicted.tale: Now %s has put you out of your home, and you stand in its streets with your coin and the tools of your trade and nowhere to sleep.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.evicted.short: Put out of your home in %s.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.hideout.tale: Now you wake in a hideout among outlaws, with the law of a realm looking for you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.cast_out.tale: Now your own kind have turned you away, and you wake outside their gates.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.cast_out.short: Turned away by your own kind.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.heirloom.tale: Now you are alone in the wild with a fine blade that carries your family's name.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.trader.tale: Now you are on a King's Road beside a milestone, with a pack mule and its load, and two orders still to be filled.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.trader.short: On a King's Road with a loaded mule.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.pup.tale: Now you are alone in the wild with a wolf pup at your heel.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.pup.short: Alone, with a wolf pup at heel.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.nobodies.tale: Now you are in the wild with three poor souls you have known for years, all of you scraping by together, and little else.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.nobodies.short: Three old companions at your back.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.city.wake: You wake inside a realm's capital, with 2 silver coins and your class's gear.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.banished.wake: You wake well past the realm's land with your class's gear. It dislikes you; its rivals like you a little.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.cave.wake: You wake underground, poisoned, wounded and barely breathing, with a pickaxe, torches and your class's gear.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.shipwreck.wake: You wake by a wreck on the shore.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.sworn.wake: You wake at the realm's keep, already sworn to it, in iron armour with a sword, a shield, two pairs of manacles and your class's gear.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.village.wake: You wake by a haven of your own people, or a village that welcomes your blood, with a random job's tools, a bed and your class's gear. Nobody there holds your blood against you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.monolith.wake: You wake within sight of a monolith. Its Giant may be near.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.skyfall.wake: You drift down into a crater far from anyone, with shards from somewhere above in your pack.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.timelost.wake: You wake in the future's ruined city with Chrono already awakened (its first ability). Dying only wakes you here again; the way back is a Chrono's leap home, once you can make one. (If the future hasn't been downloaded yet, you wait between times until it has.)
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.burned.wake: You wake sick with smoke in a burnt-out ruin in the middle of your village, with a few things you saved. The village is still burning, and the fire is spreading.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.snowed.wake: You wake high in the frozen peaks, half-frozen, with a lantern and a fur coat.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.captive.wake: You wake near a barbarian camp with nothing at all. Its raiders hunt you for a day.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.whalers.wake: You wake aboard a realm's whaler fitting out in harbour, signed on as her harpooner with harpoons, shears and oilskins. Come home aboard her for a share of the catch.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.fate.wake: Any of the starts, at random.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.unarmed.wake: You wake in the wild missing one random arm or leg. It grows back if you die, or with a Hermit Bean.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.moon.wake: You wake by your wrecked pod far out on the Pale Moon, in low gravity, with a stone pickaxe, torches and the pilot's log. Mend the pod with what the moon's ore gives and it flies you home. Until you leave, you respawn by the wreck.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.verdant.wake: Only for the Verdant-born. You wake in a village of the Verdant World with seeds, a hoe, bandages and a compass keyed to the gate down to the Lookout. Until you leave, you respawn in the village.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.rustfall.wake: You wake at a mine mouth under Rustfall's crushing weight, with a stone pickaxe and a compass to the Iron-Master's pad, where a pod stands. His overseers hunt you for a day. Until you leave, you respawn at the mine.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.maw.wake: You wake on the Maw's landing pad beside a working pod, with deck plates to build out to the wrecks and their rare loot. The pull is slow; the tide at the hole kills. Until you leave, you respawn on the pad.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.demon.wake: You wake at a demon village in the Nether, before your master's door, with a fire resistance potion and an old portal close by. The demon army leaves you be until you first leave the Nether, and you respawn there until then.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.afterlife.wake: You wake among the dead in the Other World as Divine-born, with a halo. You go back the way the dead do: the fortune teller, the tournament of the dead, or the long wait. Then you wake somewhere in the wild.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.chained.wake: You wake shackled among a barbarian camp's captives, with two lockpicks and nothing else. Hold a lockpick and use it to pick the shackle, or sneak perfectly still at night to slip it. Free, the camp hunts you for a day.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.rock_bottom.wa: You wake in the wild missing one random arm or leg, starving, with no kit at all, in sight of an outlaw camp.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.sentenced.wake: You wake in a realm's cells with two days to serve, a few coins and a lockpick. Serve them, pick the cell door (the realm then hunts you), or hold coins at the door to pay the fine in silver (3 silver for each day left). The realm thinks poorly of you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.evicted.wake: You wake in the realm's capital with 6 silver coins and your class's gear. At night the watch moves you on if you sleep or loiter in its streets, then jails you for the night, until you hold a job or have a bed of your own there.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.hideout.wake: You wake in a speakeasy's back room, or in an outlaw camp where there is none, with a few coins. A realm hates you; barbarian camps leave you be.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.cast_out.wake: Only for the Bio-built. You wake outside the gates of a haven. For three days the non-humans turn you away, and the havens' good name comes slowly and goes fast.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.heirloom.wake: You wake far from anyone with a fine blade named for your family and some bread. No armour.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.trader.wake: You wake beside a milestone on a King's Road with a pack mule, a saddle, a lead, 6 silver coins and two orders already taken from the town the road runs on to. The mule's chest holds the land's goods. A road is laid first if the world has none.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.pup.wake: You wake far from anyone with a tame wolf pup at your side and bones to feed it. It grows up over three days, and is stronger for every day it lives.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.nobodies.wake: You wake far from anyone with three poor villagers you already know, and who know you, in rags with wooden swords. They follow, carry and fight. Needs Minecraft Comes Alive.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.lab.tale: Now you are out of a locked stone room that smelled of brine and copper, with something worked into you that does not wash out.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.lab.short: Out of a hermit's lab, changed.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.lab.wake: Only for the Bio-built, Rubber-folk, Emberborn, Stoneborn and Sylvan. You wake in a small stone lab built in the wild, with one gift and one price worked into you. Clockwork golems stir and come looking for you. A Potion of Cleansing or healing magic washes the mark out.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.android.tale: Now you are standing up from a workbench that was not built for standing up from, and there is a folded note in your pocket.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.android.short: New, and still warm from the bench.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.android.wake: You wake on a tinker's bench in a small workshop built in the wild, already an android: endless ki, no hunger, metal that mends. You are given the Z Fighter's power if you have none, and a strange note in your pocket. Needs Jaymo's Powers.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.moon_cursed.ta: Now you are out under an open sky, and you cannot say why you keep looking up at the moon.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.moon_cursed.sh: Marked by something you cannot name.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.moon_cursed.wa: You wake in the wild, or at a village's edge, with a feeling you cannot name. Most nights you are yourself. Some nights, when the moon is red, you are not. A healer or a temple may know a cure.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.cave.hint: Something with too many legs has to have stopped moving first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.monolith.hint: Someone has to have finished what they set out to do first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.skyfall.hint: The sky has to have dropped something first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.timelost.hint: Someone has to have stepped out of the hours first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.cast_out.hint: The Tinkerer's work has to have been met first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.burned.hint: A fire has to have been beaten back first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.snowed.hint: Something cold and bony has to have been laid down first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.whalers.hint: Someone has to have gone to sea after something big first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.unarmed.hint: Someone has to have won with nothing but their hands first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.captive.hint: Someone has to have had a chain broken for them first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.chained.hint: Someone has to have come back from a camp's captivity first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.rock_bottom.hi: Someone has to have climbed out of the worst of it first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.sentenced.hint: Someone has to have been locked up first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.evicted.hint: Someone has to have walked out of a cell first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.hideout.hint: Someone has to have bought what no one should sell first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.heirloom.hint: Someone has to have faced a hired knife first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.trader.hint: Someone has to have carried a parcel to the right door first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.pup.hint: Someone has to have pulled a stranger out of trouble first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.nobodies.hint: Someone has to have taken on a stranger's errand first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.android.hint: Someone has to have made something stand up and walk first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.moon_cursed.hi: A red moon has to have risen and set first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.moon.hint: Someone has to have looked down on the world first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.rustfall.hint: Someone has to have walked a rusted world first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.maw.hint: Someone has to have looked into the dark between worlds first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.demon.hint: Someone has to have felt a great heat from below first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.greenskin.tale: You grew up among goblins or orcs, half one of them or simply theirs. Now you set out from their fires.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.greenskin.wake: Only for those who pass for human. You wake just outside the nearest orc camp (a half-orc) or goblin village (goblin-raised). No goblin or orc sets on you unless you strike first, your home tribe favours you, and every tribe's grudge rises slowly. Human towns treat you as the furthest thing from human; a goblin-raised human can hide it under a mask, a half-orc can't.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.greenskin.hint: Someone has to have sat at an orc's fire as a friend first.
